correctness.rationale: A Markov interval partition with open atoms and endpoint singleton states gives exact preimage edges U->V when V is contained in f(U). Every infinite backward orbit lifts a left-infinite graph walk, whose far past eventually lies in one cyclic SCC; inverse-branch contraction produces the upper bound by the closure K_C of periodic code orbits, and paths from C to V(x) give the opposite inclusion. The finite list of cyclic components makes beta constant on open atoms; a finite-step Hausdorff-hyperspace map is Baire one by continuous Minkowski arcs near each partition point. In the four-branch slope-two example the two distinct open SCCs and the endpoint-preimage bridges give beta=[0,1/2], [0,1], [1/2,1] on left, midpoint and right, hence non-continuity. Independently reconstructed the 9-node preimage graph and verified all open atoms reach P2 while left atoms do not reach right open atoms. This finite check does not establish the general SCC argument.
